heading: Tooele Wastewater Treatment and Reuse Project

tree.heading: Authorization
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with Tooele City, Utah, is authorized to participate in the design, planning, and construction of the Tooele Wastewater Treatment and Reuse Project.

tree.heading: Cost share
tree.text: The Federal share of the cost of a project described in subsection (a) shall not exceed 25 percent of the total cost.

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: The Secretary shall not provide funds for the operation or maintenance of a project described in subsection (a).
